title: kpv0(f): pytest-cov actually available in the locked dev environment
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-kpv0. Survey 2026-08-31: pyproject.toml already declares pytest-cov>=7,<8 (dev extra) and uv.lock contains it, but the installed venv (lichen-venv) lacks it, and no --cov invocation was found in current .github/workflows or scripts (bead text may be stale there). Verify: uv sync --extra dev (or the documented env bootstrap) then python -m pytest --cov=lichen --co -q on a small suite runs. If only the host venv is stale, sync/fix env wiring and document the canonical command; if no CI gate uses --cov anymore, close with evidence (no code change needed) rather than adding a gate nobody runs.
